data.title: Dale madison gave Lulu and Georgia 1 star. Check out the full review...
data.content:
* * *

## [Disappointed](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a70acd93ac9775416d0df9d)
We got this review before our furniture arrived. The bed arrived last week, but unfortunately when the guys started to put it together, they realized there was a piece missing. They had to take apart what had been done and take the whole bed with them. We’re told it would be a couple of days to bring it back. It’s been 4 days and we’ve heard nothing. They didn’t leave a name or number. So we wait until there is communication on Lulu and Georgia’s end. Frustrated and inconvenient.

July 11, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Aug 4, 2026

Hi Dale,

Thank you for your feedback. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience with your bed. Our Customer support team is currently investigating this matter with the shipper, and will follow up with a resolution shortly via your email thread. We appreciate your patience as we work towards a resolution.

Lulu and Georgia
